messages:
sam: heads up — deploybot just flagged the preflight prompt/eval for the summarizer change. landing looks like semantic drift vs baseline. need quick triage + signoff before we do the rest of the change window. dashboard: https://ci.redwood/inference/evals/2026-03-summ-v2

deploybot: PRELIGHT/EVAL ALERT for summarizer/v2.1
- gate: prompt-suite-quality
- metric: semantic_drift (lower is better)
- current: 0.27 (threshold 0.12) -> blocking = true
- sample: 500 prompts (random stratified)

lara: ugh, 0.27 is pretty high. is this concentrated on a subset of prompts or broad? :warning:

akshay: initial look — the drift seems concentrated on multi-sentence context prompts where new tuning promotes shorter outputs. quick A/B will confirm. i can spin a 10% EU canary and run the eval suite against canary vs baseline. estimated run: ~20m for collection + 15m for metric compute. to kick off: `./deploybot create-canary --release summarizer/v2.1 --region eu --pct 10 --e2e-eval prompt-suite-500`

miguel: what does product think about this? is shorter output acceptable in prod for some customers? need us to adjust release notes and any downstream CDN snippets if we proceed. tagging @sam for risk tolerance.

qa-bot: I can run the focused prompt set (edge-cases + long-context) in parallel. ETA 30m for QA run + human spot-check. link: https://qa.redwood/runs/quick-summ-2026-03

lara: suggestion: do EU canary + eval, if drift remains >0.18 then pin summarizer v2.0 for EU and route fallback for US/global. we should avoid full global rollout until we confirm revert doesn't regress other metrics.

sam: plan sounds good. action items: 1) @akshay start canary + eval now; 2) @qa-bot run quick-set; 3) @miguel confirm product sign-off for conditional EU-only pin; 4) @lara confirm holding global rollout until pass. please reply with thumbs if you agree.

akshay: starting canary now. kicking eval job, I'll post results to this thread. monitor windows: 20m collection, 15m compute, then 10m human triage. if drift delta <= 0.05 vs current 0.27 -> proceed with staggered global rollout. else -> pin EU route and open rollback ticket.

miguel: :thumbsup: product ok with conditional EU canary + pin. update release notes to call out behavior change around summary length. prepping copy now.

lara: OK. hold global rollout. i'll update the release checklist and change window notes: "If preflight drift >0.18 after EU canary, pin and open rollback per runbook." leaving final sign-off here.

sam: summary: canary started by @akshay (10% EU). QA running synthetic set. product signed off conditionally. hold global until metrics reviewed. rollback/pin criteria posted in release docs. I'll create the rollback ticket + assign on alert.

akshay: posting eval snapshot when available. pinging @sam @lara for monitoring.

sam: thanks everyone — will follow up with results and next steps.
